title: Tinubu Wins APC Presidential Primary with ~10.9 Million Votes, Securing 2027 Re-election Ticket
detail: President Bola Tinubu secured the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential ticket for the 2027 general election on May 23 after a nationwide direct primary spanning all 36 states, the Federal Capital Territory, 774 local government areas, and 8,809 wards. Tinubu received approximately 10,915,665 votes from a pool of 12,643,316 registered APC members, with accreditation recorded at 11,069,746. His sole challenger, Stanley Osifo, recorded near-zero votes in virtually all states, making the outcome a near-unanimous endorsement of the incumbent president's second-term bid. In a victory speech delivered in Abuja, Tinubu pledged to consolidate the economic reforms of his first term — including fuel subsidy removal, naira unification, and banking sector recapitalization — and vowed to restore peace and security across the country. The primary concluded the APC's broader election cycle activities, which had seen contested governorship primaries in 28 states the previous day. The party now faces a reunited opposition including the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Labour Party (LP) with former Anambra Governor Peter Obi, and potential candidates from the New Nigeria Peoples Party.
